keyFindings.description: R3's own-lines count charges the blank separator after a nested item to that item (owners at :563 gives it the innermost open item; the inside mask at :1131 keeps it because the parent's span covers it), so a nested item that is followed by a sibling may hold only 49 rows while the same item as the last child or at top level holds 50, and its verdict depends on what follows it. Repro: '- Parent item.' + blank + '  - First nested.' + 49 lines at indent 4 + blank + '  - Second nested.' -> 'R3: 51 screen rows: - First nested.', exit 1; the same item as the last child, or as a top-level item followed by a sibling, exits 0. Contradicts the comment at :1128-1130 ('from its first line to its last non-blank one'); scripts/semantic-line-breaks.test.ts:158 pins the count. Found by the reviewer and by both thermonuclear agents.

The file-head comment at :5-6 still names only packages/envoy/AGENTS.md and packages/envoy/cmd/dispatch/README.md as keeping the layout; the guides test now holds the root AGENTS.md, scripts/e2e/README.md and docs/kubernetes.md too.
